summary: A household gets a recycling pickup before the statewide start date printed on its notice.
realLife: Delaware’s advisory council reported that several haulers began single-stream service months before the residential deadline.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: actual service start and deposit status.

turns.what: A household with both services can still separate refundable bottles from curbside materials.
turns.pulledBy: Pickup is active and some store deposits are still refundable.
turns.writesBack: The household separates the two destinations.

turns.what: Where refunds have ended, an early route gives residents a collection option before the statewide deadline.
turns.pulledBy: The deposit is over but the hauler has already started its route.
turns.writesBack: The household can use its scheduled collection.
